name: Quassel-core
tagline: A modern, cross-platform, distributed IRC client, meaning that one (or multiple) client(s) can attach to and detach from a central core. This container handles the IRC connection (quasselcore) and requires a desktop client (quasselclient) to be used and configured. It is designed to be always on and will keep your identity present in IRC even when your clients cannot be online. Backlog (history) is downloaded by your client upon reconnection allowing infinite scrollback through time.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/quassel-core:0.14.0@sha256:cefb9aa752d4db099d98be5966432e9dcd298695571c8eedc84ffc298f3258e0
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      RUN_OPTS: ''
    ports:
      - target: 4242
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 113
        published: 10113
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
